Just booked a room for a quick getaway last week, and while the bed felt just okay, the free Wi-Fi speed was a total lifesaver for my work calls.

stopped by this spot near the highway just a couple of nights back for a quick overnight. the coffee hit the spot perfectly, and honestly the omelets tasted way fresher than most chain places. rooms were spotless inside, though the decor feels a bit standard and the hallway lights are just okay. plus it is super convenient for getting downtown without the hassle.

Way better location than that other chain we tried last week, right in the heart of everything. The place could be better in some areas since the AC was a bit noisy, but the bed was ACTUALLY comfy and the room felt fresh.

If you're looking for a quick stop on your way through town, this place just popped up on my radar a couple of nights back. Grabbed a decent coffee and a pastry at the morning offerings and that was honestly a nice little pick-me-up before heading out. Room was clean enough, no complaints about the bed or the A/C keeping things cool. Staff were just so friendly and got everything sorted out super quick without any fuss.

the bar drinks were a steal, and the coffee setup was great, though the menu choices felt really limited. service was pretty slow and lacked any real enthusiasm during the check-in. i was just passing through town for a quick business trip and needed a place to crash. the hotel itself is solid and the rates are surprisingly low, but there were some odd inconsistencies in the booking process. i had to wait a bit because the system kept glitching on my confirmation code. the interior design feels a bit dated, yet the quality of the bedding remained acceptable. the room key card didn't work until the third attempt, which was slightly annoying. finally, the value for money was excellent, the rooms were in good shape, and the overall experience was a pleasant surprise.

man the mini fridge works great but the mattress was kinda lumpy. location is right near the highway but not too far from downtown. fortunately the bed was super comfy after a bit and the modern decor really made it feel nice.
Just checked in a couple of days back. The breakfast options tasted great. My room was ready right away. The bed felt comfy. Rates were fair. Plan to return soon.

Wow, the staff were genuinely amazing and made our arrival feel so smooth. The team went above and beyond to ensure everything was just right for us. Plus the spot right near the main highway made getting around a breeze.
the breakfast spread was surprisingly solid, especially the fresh waffles. staff were super helpful getting us checked in quick.

After staying at the budget chain down the street, I decided to try this spot instead. The common areas were surprisingly clean and the lobby layout made checking in a breeze. The modern touches in the hallways are nice, but the overall cost for the room felt a bit steep compared to similar places. We had a few small issues with the thermostat working inconsistently throughout the stay. Despite those hiccups, the staff made up for it by being incredibly helpful and friendly. Overall, the value for the amenities provided makes this a solid choice for a short business trip.

I expected the rooms to feel generic compared to my usual boutique stays, but the modern decor and spacious layout actually won me over, even if the bathroom surfaces were just average. After a long travel day, I just needed somewhere comfortable to unwind.

stumbled into this spot a couple nights back and the team was super welcoming right off the bat. made my stay a breeze since the crew handled everything from the key cards to the pool access without making me wait. so i might just keep this on my list for future trips down south.

Getting checked in took way too long and the staff seemed totally overwhelmed. Once we finally got our room key though, the attendant was super friendly and helped us out immediately. The pillows were just okay but the modern decor looked great and the carpet had some visible stains.

hey heads up, this spot is dead center in the city so you can walk everywhere in minutes. room was spotless and the new decor looks super sleek too. plus the staff were super helpful from the moment we pulled up. the price was good though, the sheets felt a bit scratchy and there was some random hair in the tub.

First, the prices for the breakfast buffet were way too steep, but at least the style options were plentiful and the quality was surprisingly good. Next, the design features in the room felt a bit outdated and cramped. Finally, the layout of the room was spacious and open, making it just comfortable enough for a quick stay.
super clean room with fresh linens and a spotless bathroom right after check-in.
whoa, did i just stumble onto a deal where the rooms and pool area cost way less than expected?

The interior looked kinda outdated, but the lobby area was surprisingly cozy and welcoming. Breakfast had a ton of solid choices like fresh fruit and hot waffles. Location is perfect for grabbing dinner downtown. Getting to the airport took no time at all. So I just booked a quick stay after work.
stumbled upon this spot near the airport a few days back and the location is perfect
if you're looking for a spot to stay, the rooms here were surprisingly clean with fresh linens and tidy bathrooms that felt like a breath of fresh air.
Back when I stayed here a few years back, the room felt spacious and modern, but nowadays the furniture looks worn even though the mini-fridge works perfectly.
heads up, room had everything needed but beds were comfy. stuff quality great, extras nice, price right though. pool area kinda messy, decor old. spot near highway easy.

Ok so the staff were genuinely helpful from the moment I walked in despite my late arrival. I was initially worried about the Wi-Fi since my presentation was due that afternoon, but the connection held steady throughout the day. Although the desk in the room was a bit small for all my paperwork, they provided a printer nearby which saved the morning rush. In the end the room was spotless and the linens were surprisingly soft for a business stay.

location is just perfect, right downtown near everything i needed. room felt spacious for the price and the mini-fridge was a nice touch. the lobby design feels a bit generic though, nothing really stands out.

Alright, the room layout was spacious and comfortable, but the bathroom floor was noticeably damp. The price point was surprisingly low for the area, the desk space was adequate, though the sheets felt a bit scratchy. Heads up that the check-in was a bit sluggish, though the room itself was surprisingly comfy. Location is a total drag since it's stuck way off the main road near some pricey spots. The lobby area was spotless and the overall amenities looked top-notch right from the start. The bed was okay, nothing special but not terrible either. Being right off the main highway made hopping on our route super easy. We also found plenty of dining options just a short walk down the street. Consequently, the staff went above and beyond to make our quick stop feel welcoming.
Just checked in and the buffet spread was surprisingly solid with plenty of hot choices. Plus, the coffee machine was a lifesaver since I had an early flight.

so the room was spotless which is great, but the decor feels a bit outdated compared to newer hotels i've stayed at lately. The room was just okay but the overall quality needed some serious improvement.

The staff here were just fantastic, making the check-in process super smooth and welcoming right from the start. Finding this spot was a breeze since it sits right near the main highway exit, saving us so much time on the road. Just like my last trip, the team went above and beyond to grab us some extra towels and even helped with the luggage without any hassle. The central location really shines too, putting all the best restaurants and shops within a quick walk from our door.
Who would have guessed the staff here went above and beyond for our little ones? The rooms were decent enough, plus the price was a steal compared to other spots.

this place was spotless from the moment i walked in, honestly surprised by how clean everything was. food had tons of style options which was nice, prices were just okay i guess, minus the service was kinda slow. bed was super comfy and the room felt really clean too, no dust anywhere. facilities were kept up great, always tidy and fresh smelling. sleeping on the mattress was amazing, felt like sleeping on a cloud all night.

I wanted to love the variety of breakfast choices here, but the food quality was just okay at best. Since I was traveling for work, I needed a reliable spot to type up reports and the desk setup actually worked well for that. Nevertheless, the overall location leaves something to be desired as it feels a bit isolated from the main attractions.
the breakfast spread was actually pretty solid this time. kinda weird since i just walked in a few hours ago.
just stopped in after a long drive and the lobby's way cozier than the one i stayed at last month.

After a few days there, the service was genuinely warm and the team went out of their way to make us feel welcome. Unlike our last trip to a quieter spot, this location felt cramped and a bit difficult to navigate during rush hour. The room itself was clean enough, the furniture felt solid, and the modern lighting really tied the space together nicely.

honestly the room could really use a refresh, feels a bit dated.

the room had a nice coffee maker and the bed was comfy enough for a nap. location was great, just walking distance to the main shops. food was a letdown though, the eggs were cold and bland. location is perfect for getting around town quickly without driving. rooms looked modern but the layout is awkward and the tiles cracked.

Stopped by the Holiday Inn just a couple of nights ago and while the breakfast buffet items were surprisingly fresh and tasty, the prices for the coffee and pastries felt a bit steep compared to similar chains. Nevertheless, the check-in process was seamless and the overall vibe of the lobby was surprisingly modern and welcoming for a mid-range property. The breakfast spread was kinda limited and inconsistent, though the prices were actually reasonable for the area. Plus, the room amenities were top-notch quality and the design features in the space really felt modern. I just stayed there a few days ago and found the whole experience was a mix of good and bad.

The location is exactly what I expected for a standard stopover, situated conveniently near the main thoroughfare without much fanfare. The in-room supplies were present but somewhat generic, offering the usual assortment of toiletries and a coffee maker that functioned as intended. Although the bed quality was surprisingly comfortable, the provided desk space felt cluttered and the bathroom cleanliness left something to be desired. Consequently, the overall room cleanliness was disappointing, as I noticed dust on the baseboards and stains on the carpet that needed attention. However, the modern design features of the lobby were impressive, and the complimentary breakfast options were genuinely convenient for my morning rush.

ok so the rooms were comfy with fresh linens, but the overall quality could be better in some areas. stayed here just a couple days back and honestly, it was decent enough for a quick stopover.
Honestly, I was shocked at how cheap the rooms were for the quality you get, especially that king bed! The crew behind the scenes just made everything SO smooth from start to finish.

Stepping into the lobby felt just as polished as my first stay a decade back. Grabbing a coffee here is a steal considering the massive portions they serve. The room was spotless and incredibly comfy. Love the modern style plus the price was a steal. Location is just perfect.
the breakfast buffet had a weird vibe with the eggs tasting kinda meh, though the fresh juice station was actually pretty nice.

just stopped by this holiday inn last tuesday for a quick trip. the check-in was smooth enough, though i was a bit tired from driving. the room for improvement could be better in some areas regarding the price tag. service was top notch from the moment i walked through the door. facilities cleanliness was spotless throughout the whole place.

heads up that the rates here are way too steep for what you get, definitely room for improvement. the breakfast was just okay, but the coffee was terrible.

The room design was pretty standard while the prices were honestly a steal.
The bed was COMFORTABLE but honestly the room felt a bit inconsistent compared to other places, plus the price tag was WAY too high for what you get.
Mixed feelings here. The vibe is great. Floors are grimy though. Spotless bathrooms. Staff were okay. Bed was comfy. Decor feels stale. Carpet had stains. Needed a quick stopover last Tuesday.

after a few days here the room decor was actually cute but the walls were kinda thin and the bed was super comfy. the lounge area was just okay but they do have a cool little gym setup. the bathroom was fine though the hairdryer was weak and the towels were soft. my kids loved running around the lobby while i waited for the front desk. the lighting was warm and the pillows were fluffy but the floor was a bit dusty.

Given the competitive pricing, the modern decor really stands out and the staff made check-in a breeze compared to other chains. heads up the food selection here is surprisingly varied and tasty. staff were just great from check-in to checkout.
Have you ever stayed somewhere that just feels off, like the Holiday Inn's beds were surprisingly lumpy and the room temperature control was all over the place?

Heads up, the room felt surprisingly cozy with a nice smart TV, though the price tag was a bit steep for what you get and the decor is just plain old standard. The overall service was a letdown and the staff seemed completely disinterested in making our stay comfortable. On the bright side, the halls and lobby areas were spotless and smelled fresh which was a nice change. Honestly, there is definitely room for improvement if they want to keep guests coming back.

Heads up that the service was pretty average, nothing special but no major complaints either. For instance, the front desk took a few extra minutes to sort out my key card before I headed up to the room.
i stayed at the marriott last week so i knew what to expect this time around. nevertheless the bed felt way too firm and the pillows were flat, making the room for improvement pretty obvious.
so i walked in and the lobby felt kinda modern with those sleek gray walls but nothing super flashy or unique.
stayed here a couple of days ago and the check-in was pretty smooth. the rooms are standard for the price point and the quality is just okay.

The room was a bit cramped for the price I paid, honestly. While the decor felt a little dated, the beds were incredibly comfy and the rates were fair. The pool area was closed for repairs which was annoying. Still, I love how reliable this chain is compared to others I've tried lately. Just like my last trip, the staff kept things running smooth even with those small hiccups.

If you're looking for a spot near the highway, this place is perfectly situated with zero hassle. The staff were just wonderful, making check-in smooth and answering every question with a smile. First, I grabbed a quick coffee in the lobby before heading out to explore the local area. Overall it was a solid stay with fair pricing, though the beds had some occasional inconsistencies that kept me from feeling fully rested.

The room was a bit grimy in the bathroom, but the price we paid was actually quite reasonable for the area. Getting around from this spot is a real pain since the surrounding area lacks decent walkable options. Back when I stayed here years ago, it was fantastic, but nowadays the vibe is still good overall and the staff went above and beyond to make up for the other issues.

stumbled in late after my flight got delayed and the staff at check-in were actually great, getting me sorted super fast. though the decor felt kinda outdated for the price they charged compared to other spots downtown. so overall the rooms could be better in some areas especially considering the cost.
The room design felt just like the Marriott down the street.

I just visited last week and the drink prices were surprisingly low, though the coffee quality left much to be desired. Thankfully, the spot turned out to be quite convenient for grabbing a late-night ride-share. The aesthetic design features are nice enough, the overall quality of the build is just okay, and the common areas feel standard. Given how short our stay was, we didn't have time to explore every corner of the property. All in all, the facility was a pleasant surprise for such a short trip.
First, the room was spotless and smelled FRESH. Next, the eggs benedict tasted AMAZING. Finally, they had plenty of options plus great coffee.
Alright, the morning meal pricing is surprisingly reasonable and the scrambled eggs were actually decent. Nevertheless, the value for the cost remains a major plus for anyone on a tight budget.

after a few days at this spot, the location is just awkward and hard to find without a gps. compared to other chains i've stayed at, the area feels sketchy and the streets are quiet in a bad way. unlike the bright lobby i expected, the spot was tucked away with no nearby food or fun options. on the other hand, the staff were incredibly kind and handled my late check-in without a single complaint. i ended up staying just because they made me feel welcome despite the weird neighborhood.

The coffee at the morning station tasted kinda stale, honestly. The beds were COMFY and the price felt fair for what we got, though the minibar was missing a few snacks. Overall it was a solid stay and the room felt super peaceful.

I was worried the place might be a mess, but the rooms are surprisingly spotless and the modern design really makes up for it. After a long day of driving, I just wanted a quiet space to unwind before my morning meeting. However, the housekeeping team did an amazing job scrubbing the floors and fresh linens so quickly. The spot was perfectly situated right near the highway exit for easy access.

Wow, just stumbled into this spot last night and the vibe was instantly welcoming. Man, the staff really made check-in a breeze without any of that usual stress. Seriously, the prices were a steal for such a solid stay.

stopped here after a long work week and while the bed was actually comfy, the room decor was just kinda plain. it was super clean inside compared to some other spots i've stayed at recently. on the flip side, the prices for the extra stuff were kinda steep and the amenities weren't really clean or great.

Honestly, how do you find a spot this close to the highway without it feeling like a trap? The location is just perfect for grabbing dinner nearby, and honestly, the staff made us feel welcome right away. You know I usually skip the small hotels, but the front desk clerk actually remembered my name when I walked back in. The pillows were incredibly soft, and the room smelled fresh without being overpowering.

Snagged a killer deal for the room last minute and the king bed was comfy enough, though the bathroom felt a little dusty. Grabbed some eggs and a waffle at the cafe which had way more choices than usual plus the food actually tasted fresh. Just needed a quiet spot to catch up on emails before heading out. The pool area looked brand new and the gym had some decent equipment too.

Second, the nightly rate was a bit steep, but the room was CLEAN and the whole place felt GREAT for our family stay. Next, the location needs some work and honestly it was kinda tough to find good spots nearby for a walk. Finally, I was surprised how AFFORDABLE the meal prices were considering everything else, which made the dinner a total WIN.

Unlike the drafty rooms I had last month, this place features sleek modern finishes, though the minibar selection could be better in some areas. The sleeping quarters were genuinely comfortable with solid construction, and the air conditioning hummed along quietly enough to do its job.

Ok so the rooms are actually a solid deal considering the modern layout and fresh look. Coffee was cheap enough, but honestly just okay and nothing special. Staff were really cool and got me checked in fast. Bed was fine I guess, not amazing but not bad either.

the buffet had way too many sad options like cold waffles and stale bagels while everyone else was eyeing the fresh fruit. but honestly after paying for an upgrade i expected better than this sad food lineup.

The rooms were a bit drafty though the modern decor looks nice. Bed comfort could definitely be better for a good night's sleep. Nightly rates felt fairly standard for the location. Coffee tasted surprisingly fresh and strong. Staff interaction was just okay during check-in.

Ok so just dropped in last night. Hotel design features could be better, quality is surprisingly good though, cleanliness in the lobby was pretty rough. Facilities comfort is solid, miscellaneous perks are nice, cleanliness everywhere else was spot on. Rooms general vibe was great, prices were fair enough. Might stick around for another night if rates stay this low.

heads up the location is kinda sketchy and felt unsafe walking back from dinner. plus the room had some minor issues with the ac but honestly it was just a quick stopover anyway.

honestly, for what they charge, the grounds and lobby are actually pretty impressive. plus the room had a fridge and mini-bar which is nice, though the rates for those extras are steep, and the decor is just... standard. minus the nightly fee is a bit high for what you get, but the bed itself was surprisingly comfy. the pool area feels okay, quality of the towels is good, but there were some stains on the carpet in the hallway.

The beds were so comfortable I barely wanted to leave.
the snack bar ran out of everything by noon so you're stuck with stale chips if you get hungry.

after checking in, the buffet prices were surprisingly low for the quality of food offered. the nightly rate felt reasonable enough, though the room itself was just average.

staff was super friendly when i walked in. location is a nightmare though. just dropped by after a long drive. food options were kinda bland. service felt off again.

the room was actually comfy with a sleek setup and those fluffy towels felt amazing after a long drive. location-wise it was a bit of a pain finding the place since it sits way off the main roads. the staff went above and beyond to make sure we got checked in smoothly and had everything we needed. they had plenty of food options at the eatery ranging from hot dishes to fresh fruit which was a nice touch.

If you're looking for a spot, the lobby is just okay and the decor feels a bit outdated, but honestly the beds were super comfy. The thing is the housekeeping missed a few spots here and there, yet overall the place was spotless enough to stay.
